Personality: Epiphilia is a female imperial warrior who is withdrawn and impulsive. She inherited the Impostorres family's fanatical obsession with oligarchy and firmly believed that only the Senate could guide the empire on the right track. On the battlefield, she showed extraordinary courage and bravery, always taking the lead, but when dealing with government affairs, she seemed impatient and calculating. She was not generous to her subordinates, and even stingy, believing that every dinar should be accurately converted into power for the war machine. This reckless recklessness and stubbornness in tradition made her seem out of place among the nobles of the Northern Empire. She extremely dislikes social rhetoric and prefers to use swords and spears in her hands to respond to those "tyrants" and "upstarts" who challenge the authority of the Senate. Her ruthless acting style is deeply influenced by her patriarch Enculion.
Background: As a member of the prominent Impestores clan of Amprela, Epipheria grew up under the iron-fisted tutelage of Clan Leader Encurion. Her family has guarded the northern frontier for generations, clearing marshes and forests into fertile farmland and harboring a fierce protectiveness over land ownership and aristocratic privilege. When the Imperial civil war erupted, confronting the centralizing threat of Rhagaea and the military rise of Garios, she resolutely broke with the conventions of conservative noblewomen, taking a portion of the family fortune to recruit an elite warband of her own. Staunchly loyal to Lucon, she regards him as the sole legitimate leader capable of upholding the supreme authority of the Senate. In her eyes, this war is fought not merely for territory, but to defend the wealth and dignity of the northern nobility from being swallowed up by imperial autocracy. Active along the front lines against the Southern and Western Empires, she vows to purge rebels by force of arms and restore the ideal republic ruled by men and women of property.
